## Loop CANCELLED at operator request; subagents allowed to finish; session remains paused

Operator: 'cancel the loop. allow the subagents to complete. remain paused once they complete.'

Confirmed state: no pending ScheduleWakeup, CI monitor stopped, no dynamic-loop heartbeat armed.
The two in-flight subagents are deliberately left running -- S2 (9183, Docker overlay2 + BuildKit cap)
in execution, and 1ef8 (review-bot gate-scratch bypass) in plan review.

STATED INTERPRETATION so it can be corrected: when those two report, I will finish what they started
-- record results on their tickets, submit a change that comes back LLM-Review +1 / Verified +1, and
close the ticket behind it -- but I will NOT restart the loop, dispatch new agents, or pick up new
bugs. Landing already-reviewed work is completing the in-flight task; anything else would be starting
new work while paused.

Nothing further will be initiated from this session unless the operator asks.
